title: Clinical Professor of Law, Emeritus
bio: Professor Price is a practicing lawyer engaged in a variety of transactional law areas. He founded and directed the Transactional Law Clinics, consisting of the Business and Non-Profit Clinic, Real Estate Clinic, Entertainment Law Clinic and Community Enterprise Project (CEP). The clinics educate and train 2L and 3L students in the practice of law as they render legal services to hundreds of […]
